label: AAS to S3 Bridge
info:
Publishes an AAS shell (+ submodels) from the local Basyx server to an S3-compatible bucket (Cloudflare R2) and registers the corresponding Asset/ContractDefinition offer with the EDC Management API as a plain HttpData asset (same shape as the existing 'Create Asset' dashboard), pointing at the object's public R2 URL.

Set the following environment variables on this tab (Edit Flow -> Environment Variables) or as process env vars on the Node-RED host:
- BASYX_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8081)
- BACKEND_API_KEY
- S3_BUCKET
- S3_REGION (R2: leave as 'auto')
- S3_ENDPOINT (R2 only, e.g. https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com) - used for the upload (S3 API)
- S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL (R2 "Public Development URL", e.g. https://pub-xxxxxxxx.r2.dev) - used for the EDC asset's baseUrl
- AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (R2 API token with Object Read & Write, scoped to the bucket)
- EDC_MANAGEMENT_URL (e.g. https://hni-01.c-27d7c36.kyma.ondemand.com/management)
- EDC_API_KEY
- EDC_ACCESS_POLICY_ID / EDC_CONTRACT_POLICY_ID (created once via the bootstrap script or the existing Provider dashboard, then reused for every asset)

Requires the @aws-sdk/client-s3 npm package installed in the Node-RED user directory, and a Node-RED runtime on Node.js >= 18 (for global fetch).

name: Check API Key
Build Basyx Shell URL
Validate shell response
Stash shell, check for submodels
Build Basyx Submodel URL
Combine shell + submodels
Upload to S3 + Register EDC Offer
